dataset.published_review_detail: factual status, original dimension ratings, null overall score and short bilingual comments only

limitations: All profiles/jobs are fictional. Native scores and judgments are unvalidated, not HR ground truth or hiring predictions.
Factual source views and brief score/comment records are partial public derivatives, not complete originals or a historical replay package.

Original resume bytes and factual text are preserved. Evaluations publish only the original dimension ratings, factual-status label, null overall score and brief bilingual summaries. Other partial-score fields and detailed review bases remain private; no numerical aggregate score is invented.

No case-level detailed reasoning, claim assessments, coverage records, evidence/source mappings, quotations, design notes, preset answers, prompts, ledgers, gaps, provenance, predecessor records or raw review internals are distributed.
Ordinary isolated software assertions are retained as tests, not as preset answers for these140cases.
Current-tree removal does not erase older Git history. Private originals remain unchanged.
No model-weight training, paid model call, quality improvement, rendered-document verification, ATS certification or production readiness is established.
This manifest lists current selected public bytes; it does not contain hashes of omitted private original case records. Its own bytes are separately bound by the Git blob/commit.
